**The Resale Revolution Starts With You!**

As a Crossroads Buyer, you will bring our brand promise to life: to offer a fun, fashion-centered, and affordable shopping experience to our communities. You’ll hand select items to sell in our stores and provide a high-level of customer service. You’ll get customers excited about shopping and selling second-hand fashion, whether it’s their first time or their 1000th!  
  
**Minimum Requirements:**

* Must be able to work a minimum of 12 hours per week.
* 6+ months of retail experience.
* Have a good eye for fashion and current trends.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

When you join Crossroads, you are joining the sustainable fashion movement and reshaping fashion culture. And you aren’t just impacting the planet’s future- you are impacting your own.

* We have clear paths for promotion and several routes you can take as you embark on your second-hand retail journey.
* You’ll learn how to run a second-hand business– you’ll embody an entrepreneurial spirit- learning everything from buying, merchandising and inventory practices to gaining and maintaining the trust of a customer base who has been devoted since day one.

**You are:**

* **A Team Player**. You are as enthusiastic about the success of others as you are about your own success.
* **Authentic**. You are your unique self!
* **Fashion-focused.** You eat, breathe, and sleep style. Fashion is life.
* **Adaptable**. You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We problem-solve together!
* **People**-**first**. You are energized by people. You radiate kindness and positivity! You understand your impact and are someone who uplifts others.

**You will:**

* **Engage**. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet each customer with a smile and welcome them to our store. Create a welcoming, fun, and inclusive environment to shop and work in.
* **Ask and Educate**. You will teach our customers how we work and get them excited about selling their clothes to us!
* **Have Integrity**. You will act with integrity in words and actions- do the right thing and do it right, even when it’s difficult.
* **Be Compassionate**. You will embody our core values of service, inclusion, and education. It’s important that we connect with all customers and try our best to help them.
* **Be Reliable**. You will show up to work on time and ready to go!
* **Be Flexible**. You understand that needs change and evolve throughout the day- you know how to support your team and customer as needed.
* **Enjoy Organizing.** Cleaning, organizing, and merchandising are all parts of the job and help create the best possible shopping and working environment.

**Perks:**

**Health + Wellbeing**

**We will:**

* **Support your wellbeing**. We care about our employees holistically and offer sick paid time off.
* **Prioritize wellness for all.** We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance for ALL employees who work at least 20 hours a week!

**Work/Life Harmony**

**We will:**

* **Give you incentives when you work during the holidays.** We pay time and a half on select holidays throughout the year, and we are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.
* **Encourage work/life balance.** We offer flexible scheduling so that you can meet work & life needs!

**Financial Health**

**We will:**

* **Contribute to your 401(k)**. Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you enroll & an additional discretionary 2% at year-end! We offer both a Roth and traditional 401(k).
* **Offer** a generousdiscount on all merchandise including luxury consignment pieces- shop where you work!
* **Be Transparent.** We have clear pay ranges and always advertise pay for positions. We believe in pay equity.
* **Offer Earned Wage Access.** Need money before payday? You’ll be able to access pay as you earn it through our partner app ZayZoon
* **Contribute** **to Commuter Benefits**. Take public transit? We’ll contribute and match a portion of your commuter account monthly.

**Growth + Development**

**We will:**

* **Let you take the lead.** We offer clear paths for growth and ongoing professional development that are straightforward and attainable.
* **Celebrate with you**. We’ll provide you with many opportunities to bond with your team as you celebrate successes together.
* **Equip you with the tools to be successful**. As you onboard & throughout your career, our training programs will set you up to win.

  

**About Crossroads**

One of the first companies to pioneer secondhand clothing as an alternative to traditional retail, Crossroads Trading has been buying, selling, and consigning name brand and designer clothing in a friendly, fun, and fashionable atmosphere since 1991.

Since opening the doors of its first location in the heart of San Francisco’s Fillmore District, Crossroads has expanded over time to 38 retail locations spanning Northern and Southern California, Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Denver, New York, and Houston. And in recent years, we have added Sell-By-Mail and Concierge programs to provide convenient new ways for fashionable and eco-conscious customers to sell their gently used clothing.

Crossroads has been featured in Harper’s Bazaar, Teen Vogue, and LA Mag, and is widely recognized as an industry leader in the ‘resale revolution.’

**If you like sustainability, fashion, and working in a fun, positive environment, you’ll enjoy a career with us!**

* Experience contributing to SSPs, POA&Ms, contingency plans (ISCP), and incident response plans (IRP).
* Experience writing and maintaining audit-ready governance artifacts, including policies, standards, procedures, and control narratives.
* Experience coordinating with 3PAOs, auditors, or assessors during annual assessments or continuous monitoring cycles.
* Ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, and Security to drive control implementation and remediation without direct authority.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent audit and assessment timelines and track findings through closure.
* Experience using AI to automate or streamline manual compliance workflows.

* CISSP, CISM, CISA, or other information security certifications
* Experience with DoD Impact Level authorizations and CMMC certification

jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 173653
  
  
**Job Category:** Accounting / Finance
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Finance
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  
Department Overview
  
  
Capital Accounting plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy of PG&E's financial information related to Plant, Accumulated Depreciation, Construction Work in Progress, Assets Acquisitions, Sales, Retirements, Nuclear Decommissioning accounting and Asset Retirement Obligations. The team works with various stakeholders throughout PG&E to maintain effective oversight and understanding of the Company’s capital expenditures and capital related business processes. The work of our department is key to the Company and provides challenge and variety including application of appropriate accounting treatment and analyses under GAAP, FERC, Tax and SEC reporting for transactions relating to capital assets at PG&E.
  
  
The Company plans to spend $12 billion on capital expenditure in the coming year. The work of this high-profile team will provide the successful candidate with challenge and variety as well as exposure to key individuals throughout the company.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Join PG&E's Capital Accounting team and play a key role in accounting for more than $125 billion in property plant and equipment and $5.5 billion in asset retirement obligations that help power and serve millions of Californians.
  
  
As a Senior Accounting Analyst , you'll work cross functionally by partnering with stakeholders across the company to support major infrastructure investments and critical financial reporting processes. This is a highly visible role that offers the opportunity to solve complex business and accounting challenges, influence key decisions, and contribute to initiatives with significant financial impact.
  
  
We're looking for a motivated professional who enjoys analyzing complex issues, working with large and diverse data sets, and translating technical accounting concepts into clear and actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, critical thinker, and collaborative partner who thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to expand their expertise while making a meaningful contribution to PG&E's mission.
  
  
This position follows a hybrid work model, combining remote work with regular in-person collaboration at the Oakland General Office , generally one day per week or more based on business needs.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
Participate in the day-to-day operations of the accounting group to ensure that monthly responsibilities are completed by the prescribed due dates.
  
Maintain proper internal controls and review of all areas of responsibility to determine compliance with accounting policies.
  
Participate in researching GAAP and regulatory guidance to determine the appropriate accounting treatment.
  
Complete monthly accounting journal entries, account reconciliations, monthly roll forward schedule and related variance analysis associated with Asset Retirement Obligations, Nuclear Decommissioning accounting, Property Plant & Equipment and Accumulated Depreciation.
  
Collaborate with team members to maintain the ongoing development and compliance with departmental policies and procedures.
  
Lead and implement process improvements and the development of financial reporting tools.
  
Develop expertise in the capital asset life cycle and take ownership of related accounting issues.
  
Work closely with management and related departments, including internal and external reporting groups, Tax, Regulatory departments, and various lines of business.
  
Responsible for ensuring the integrity of several portions of the financial statements by performing timely and efficient analytics.
  
Perform special projects as requested by the supervisor and manager.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
BA/BS in Accounting, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  
4 years of recent relevant accounting experience
  
  
**Desired:**  
Strong knowledge of GAAP, SEC, and FERC requirements
  
Proficient computer skills (Excel/Word/PowerPoint)
  
Knowledge of financial analysis and internal controls
  
Knowledge of SAP
  
Knowledge of Power Plan software
  
Knowledge of Utility ratemaking
  
CPA or equivalent or substantially complete
  
Public Accounting experience
  
Excellent research and issue resolution skills
  
Demonstrates advanced knowledge in technical/professional concepts
  
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact

**The Role**

We are seeking a highly motivated finance leader to join our team as a **Sr. Manager, FP&A** responsible for our hyperscaler and cloud infrastructure spend, including Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will own assortment strategy and business performance for your assigned product areas, translating customer insights, market opportunities, and Thuma’s design point of view into compelling products and profitable growth.

Working closely with Merchandising leadership, Design, Product Development, Sourcing, and Inventory Planning, you will bring a clear merchant perspective from initial concept through launch and ongoing performance. The right person balances creative judgment with financial discipline and moves comfortably between strategy and hands on execution.

Thuma’s Headquarters is based in the historic Presidio neighborhood of San Francisco. This is a hybrid role that will be in office 3 - 5 days a week.

### **You Will**

**Assortment Strategy and Product Direction**

* Develop assortment plans for assigned product areas, identifying opportunities for newness, expansion, refinement, and discontinuation.
* Use customer feedback, competitive research, and business performance to recommend clear product priorities that support Thuma’s roadmap and create Oasis.
* Define commercial product briefs, including customer needs, assortment positioning, target retail prices, and margin goals; partner with Design, Product Development, and Sourcing to bring them to life.

* Recommend pricing and lifecycle decisions using product costs, competitive positioning, customer value, and financial performance.

**Product Development and Launch Execution**

**Product Storytelling and Presentation**

**Job Title:** Purchasing Specialist (Buyer)  
**Job Location:** San Francisco-USA-94128  
**Work Location Type:** On-Site  
**Salary Range:** $25.00 - 32.00 per hour

**About us**
------------

Since 1942, SkyChefs has taken culinary excellence to new heights. As a trusted partner to the nation’s leading airlines and retailers, we proudly deliver millions of meals and exceptional service experiences every year across 43 sites throughout the United States. Built on a legacy of operational excellence, culinary expertise, and continuous innovation, we are committed to setting the industry standard in aviation culinary, airline services, last-mile logistics, and retail commerce. From the kitchen to the runway, our teams work together to deliver quality, reliability, and service at every altitude. Our people are the heart of everything we do. At SkyChefs, a career is more than a job – it’s an opportunity to grow, lead, and make an impact in a fast-paced, team-driven environment. Join America’s first, foremost, and finest and take your career to new heights.

**Role Purpose Statement**
--------------------------

The plays a vital role in supporting an efficient and reliable supply chain by sourcing, purchasing, and managing assigned categories of goods and services. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong supplier relationships while ensuring the timely availability of products needed to support daily operations.

Key responsibilities include procuring produce, frozen foods, and other food-related commodities, monitoring inventory levels, and managing expired or obsolete inventory to minimize waste, control costs, and maximize operational efficiency.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, vendors, and Customer Service Center teams, the Buyer helps drive supply chain performance by ensuring product availability, maintaining cost-effective purchasing practices, and supporting the delivery of exceptional service to both internal and external customers. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound decision-making, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**Main Accountabilities**
-------------------------

* Conduct market research on products, suppliers, and pricing to identify sources that meet customer specifications, quality standards, and business requirements.
* Monitor product costs and market trends, proactively recommending solutions to mitigate the impact of price fluctuations.
* Strategically source food ingredients and products to achieve the optimal balance of cost, quality, and availability while meeting customer and Retail Sales requirements.
* Coordinate purchasing activities with vendors, including pricing updates, order cancellations, discontinued items, approved substitutions, backorders, delivery schedule changes, and invoice discrepancy resolution.
* Prepare, analyze, and maintain ingredient costing throughout the menu development process, incorporating supplier cost revisions as needed.
* Leverage knowledge of product availability, supplier capabilities, and industry innovations to recommend standardized products and value-driven solutions to customers.
* Support customer projects by ensuring purchases align with negotiated pricing agreements and established sourcing strategies.
* Assist with menu presentation preparation, including ordering product samples, confirming receipt, and collaborating with Category Managers to validate ingredient and packaging costs.
* Partner with Program Management and Pricing teams to ensure sourced products meet customer specifications and program requirements.
* Establish and maintain new product records within distribution and internal LSG systems.
* Collaborate with Customer Service Centers (CSC) to minimize dead stock inventory through resale opportunities, inventory transfers, or salvage solutions.
* Negotiate supplier agreements, evaluate vendor quotations, and ensure competitive pricing and product specifications through strategic sourcing and supplier benchmarking.
* Support Quality Assurance initiatives by collecting and maintaining product specifications, nutritional information, and related documentation.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**  

* Customer satisfaction and responsiveness
* On-time and within-budget completion of sourcing and customer projects
* Product cost optimization and savings achievement
* Supplier performance and service levels
* Inventory management and reduction of excess/dead stock
* Process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives
* Compliance with customer specifications, quality standards, and purchasing policies

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
------------------------------------

1 to 3 years of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or related experience required  
Working knowledge of SAP preferred  
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and business partners  
Proven ability to collaborate successfully in a team-oriented environment  
Strong multitasking, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced setting  
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support informed business decisions

Lead key components of the accounting and reporting close process.  
Apply accounting and financial principles to support accurate financial reporting and sound decision making.  
Assess the effectiveness of controls in your area and participate in the design of new controls for emerging and growing business activities.  
Exercise judgment to drive decisions and keep projects moving to close the books each month.  
Take full ownership of your area and drive issues to resolution.  
Analyze complex processes and systems data to identify root causes and surface insights.  
  
A day in the life  
This role sits at the intersection of accounting, tax, and technology. You'll be involved in the monthly close cycle, operationalizing new intercompany agreements, testing calculations before they go live, supporting internal controls work, and jumping in on audit requests when needed.

new_jobs.description:
ServiceTitan is seeking an exceptional Senior Financial Analyst, GTM FP&A to join our finance organization in a highly visible and impactful role. The primary focus for this role will be serving as a dedicated FP&A partner who is embedded in the business, close to the decisions that matter, and trusted to bring both the numbers and the narrative.

  

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excel in the ability to work collaboratively across teams, thrive in fast-paced ambiguous environments and have a growth mindset with strong curiosity about our business and industry. At ServiceTitan, we value strategic thinking at every level of the organization. You will be empowered to challenge the status quo, dream big, and drive meaningful impact as we pursue ambitious goals together.

**What you'll do:**

* Drive the monthly close process: have a deep understanding of monthly performance, prepare variance commentary, understand accruals, and raise any risks and opportunities to both finance and GTM leadership teams
* Manage headcount and expense planning: lead the monthly forecasts and annual operating plan to translate business needs among the GTM teams you support into accurate forecasts
* Turn data into decisions: build a deep command of the P&L to diagnose what's driving performance, shape strategic narratives, and partner with leadership on high-impact, ad hoc analyses that move the business forward
* Dig into the data: uncover trends, risks, and opportunities by understanding the unit economics and efficiency drivers that underpin the business, and come to the table with a clear point of view on budget and financial trade-offs
* Be a trusted business partner: become the finance voice leadership turns to for clarity on performance, strategic trade-offs, and the decisions that define how the business grows
* Leverage AI and drive process improvements: identify areas to automate, accelerate, and sharpen the work across the team

**What you’ll bring:**

* 4-year degree in a relevant field with strong academic performance
* 3–5+ years in FP&A, strategic finance, or a related analytical role preferably at a high growth technology company
* Experience in financial modeling and strategic business planning, including the creation and execution of robust financial plans
* Comfortable solving problems and operating with autonomy in a fast-moving ambiguous environment
* Strong understanding of FP&A fundamentals (variance analysis, variance storytelling, budgeting, forecasting, headcount management, reporting)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to both finance and non-finance audiences
* AI-forward - you actively use AI tools to work faster and go deeper

**About NATco**

NATco, North American Textile Co., LLC, is a leading provider of apparel branding and packaging solutions with more than 50 years of industry experience. Headquartered in Glendale, California, we serve customers worldwide through our global manufacturing operations and comprehensive product offerings.

**Position Summary**

North American Textile Co., LLC is seeking a detail-oriented **Accountant, FP&A** to support accounting operations, month-end closing, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. The ideal candidate has strong accounting, analytical, and organizational skills and works effectively across departments.

This is a **full-time position based onsite in Glendale, California, five days per week.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Planning & Analysis**

* Support the annual budgeting and financial planning process.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial forecasts.
* Analyze actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods and explain significant variances.
* Prepare financial models, forecasts, and scenario analyses to support business decisions.
* Assist in developing revenue, expense, profitability, and cash-flow forecasts.
* Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators.

* Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.

* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and communicate findings to management.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
* Effective organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across departments.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling financial and business information.
* Reliable transportation and the ability to work onsite at the Glendale office five days per week.
* Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record for occasional local travel, including bank deposits.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ERP systems such a **SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or Microsoft Dyanmics**.
* Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Knowledge of U.S. GAAP.
* Experience preparing management reporting and financial dashboards.
* Power BI or other business intelligence experience is a plus.
* Experience in a multinational or manufacturing environment is preferred.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Deliver accurate and timely financial reports.
* Maintain reliable financial models and forecasts.
* Provide meaningful variance analysis and actionable insights.
* Support a timely and accurate month-end close.
* Improve reporting efficiency through automation and advanced Excel capabilities.
* Maintain strong data integrity and financial controls.
* Partner effectively with cross-functional teams and management.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to remain seated and work at a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to use standard office equipment, including computers, printers, scanners, and calculators.
* Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and electronically.
* Ability to occasionally lift and carry files, supplies, or packages weighing up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to drive occasionally for business-related purposes.

This is a full-time, onsite position based in Glendale, California. Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of the position. The employee must be available to work occasional overtime when required.

new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

BryceTech is a trusted leader in complex technology domains, delivering data-driven solutions in aerospace, biosecurity, and defense. We specialize in systems engineering, advanced analytics, R&D programs, and strategic advisory support. Our clients – including NASA, DoD, HHS, DHS, and other civil and national security agencies – rely on us to drive mission success and accelerate innovation.

BryceTech has been recognized in the *Washington Technology* Fast 50 ranking of top high-growth small businesses for five consecutive years and received a GovCon Contractor of the Year Award in 2025, underscoring our strong growth, competitive positioning, and excellence in federal contracting. With a proven track record of winning sought-after contracts, scaling high-performance teams, and executing on critical government missions, BryceTech presents a compelling opportunity for strategic partnerships in the GovCon space.

 **Job Description**

BryceTech is seeking a Senior Acquisition Program Analyst to provide acquisition management and program support to U.S. Space Force organizations in El Segundo, California. The Senior Acquisition Program Analyst will support the Government’s “Engine Room” and Strategy Cell by analyzing acquisition and program information, coordinating actions across stakeholders, supporting program execution, and developing decision-quality products for Government leadership. The position will work across functional and organizational boundaries to help identify issues, assess impacts, track actions, and support timely execution of acquisition priorities.

Responsibilities

* Provide acquisition management and program analysis support for complex DoD space programs
* Support the Government’s Engine Room and Strategy Cell in coordinating acquisition activities, priorities, taskers, and program actions
* Analyze acquisition, programmatic, financial, schedule, performance, and requirements information to identify trends, issues, risks, and potential impacts
* Research and synthesize large amounts of information into concise summaries, briefings, reports, and other decision-support products
* Track and coordinate workflow taskers, suspense dates, action items, and deliverables across Government organizations and mission partners
* Support acquisition planning, program execution, requirements development, and cross-functional coordination
* Coordinate with Government stakeholders, contractors, and mission partners to obtain information, resolve issues, and maintain alignment with program objectives
* Prepare and review acquisition documentation, correspondence, briefings, reports, spreadsheets, and executive-level decision materials
* Support the development of recommendations and courses of action by evaluating program information, identifying potential solutions, and assessing associated impacts
* Assist with monitoring program cost, schedule, performance, funding, contracting, and requirements activities
* Support senior Government leadership with timely analysis, status updates, and decision-quality information
* Utilize Government acquisition, cost, requirements, reporting, and task-management systems to support program activities
* Perform other acquisition management and program analysis duties as required to support the mission

  
**Qualifications**  

* Active DoW Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility (TS/SCI)
* Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited college or university in management, business, economics, finance, accounting, mathematics, science, technology, engineering, statistics, or a related field
* 20+ years of relevant experience supporting acquisition, program management, business management, or operations activities, preferably within the DoD or space domain
* PMT 4010 Certificate (or predecessor course), demonstrating qualification to support DoD ACAT I and II acquisition programs
* Knowledge of DoD acquisition processes and the mission-critical aspects of space launch, ground, and sustainment programs
* Experience analyzing and synthesizing complex program or acquisition information and communicating findings to Government stakeholders
* Experience coordinating taskers, action items, deliverables, and suspense requirements across multiple organizations
* Experience developing briefings, reports, spreadsheets, executive summaries, and other acquisition or program management products
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and PowerPoint
* Familiarity with DoD acquisition, cost, requirements, and reporting systems and processes
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively using appropriate DoD and Space Force acquisition terminology
* Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to identify issues, assess impacts, and develop actionable recommendations

  
**Additional Information**

Position is contingent upon contract award.

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**Job Summary**

ASSA ABLOY is seeking a Sr. Financial Analyst who will play a critical role in supporting the financial planning, analysis, and decision-making processes within the Pfister business segment. This position will partner with cross-functional teams to provide insights, develop financial models, and support strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience in a manufacturing environment, and the ability to communicate financial data effectively.

  

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* (40%) Support the Retail Sales Team by providing financial planning and analysis support. Projects include reviewing and financial modeling of pricing discounts, customer programming, and sales reporting. Individual will work closely with sales department to improve customer profitability and focus on driving the necessary culture and processes.
* (10%) Maintain a strong control environment over the Price Change Request (PCR)\ Job Quote process and other program change requests.
* (10%) Collaborate closely with accounting and functional finance teams to ensure alignment on financial allocation methodologies and maintain the integrity of financial reporting.
* (15%) Investigate variances against historical performance and forecasts, identifying and highlighting key business drivers and trends. Perform in-depth monthly analysis of Business Area financial results and prepare comprehensive management presentations to inform strategic decision-making.
* (10%) Provide actionable financial insights to assess risks and uncover opportunities, proactively identifying issues and recommending solutions to achieve financial commitments.
* (10%) Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations, analyze reserve balances, and month-end journal entries related to customer programming, bonus accrual, and sales commissions.
* (5%) Prepare & present financial results to management using PowerPoint.

  

**Education and Experience Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in a financial analyst role supporting a sales organization, preferably in the consumer products or building industry
* Ability to build strong relationships and sense of urgency
* Strong ability to communicate analysis and recommendations to a non-technical audience.
* Demonstrated drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques.
* Advanced Excel skills are required.
* Ability to compile large amounts of data into useful information
* Strong P&L and invoice experience

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MS Power BI
* Experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding of business forecasting and financial modeling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional coordination.
* Comprehensive understanding of P&L analysis, covering revenue, COGS, and operating margin.

**Critical Skills**

* Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
* Nimble Learning: Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.
* Being Resilient: Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.
* Optimizes Work Process: Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Demonstrates self-awareness: Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

  

**Work Environment:**

  

This position will be Hybrid (onsite Tuesday through Thursday) based in Lake Forest, California.

The annual salary for this role is $81,802-$128,546.

  

The final pay rate offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role. Benefits and additional compensation offered for this position are

* Paid time off, including sick and vacation days
* 12 paid holidays
* Job-protected leave benefits in accordance with applicable law
* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* Supplemental critical illness, hospital, accident, and indemnity available for purchase
* Health and flexible savings accounts subject to eligibility requirements
* 401(k) plan with employer contributions and matching subject to plan eligibility requirements
  

All benefits and additional compensation are governed by applicable Company policies and plans as they currently exist and may be amended in the future.

  

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact AAAR.Recruiting@assaabloy.com.

  

*We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

new_jobs.title: Project and Financial Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  
  
To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

The School of Medicine has recently completed construction on a new cGMP Facility, following Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs). A cGMP facility is a production facility for the manufacturing of pharmaceutical or cellular products. It includes the manufacturing space, the storage warehouse for raw and finished product and support laboratory areas, including quality control and quality assurance programs, to control collection, processing, storage and release of cell therapy products. At UCI, the cGMP facility will enable clinical trials of cell therapeutics, including stem cell populations and bone marrow transplantation, as well as Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T-cells. The facility includes a seven-room GMP cellular therapy and viral vector facility, with an adjacent quality control laboratory.

  
Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Research Operations, this role is responsible for executing project management and financial operations within a regulated clinical manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate possesses a foundational background in biological sciences and a sophisticated understanding of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) specific to cell and gene therapies, along with basic accounting principles. Operating with a degree of autonomy, the incumbent oversees end-to-end procurement pipelines and drives cross-functional project alignment across all internal GMP teams to support the seamless production of biological products. In addition, the incumbent will be responsible for all purchasing and invoicing activities. They will also Assist development of scope of work, budgets, and reports for project requirements in consultation with GMP leadership.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Demonstrate technical skills in project management with the flexibility to handle multiple tasks.
* Process-oriented with strong analytical skills for risk identification and management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and can confidently communicate with all levels of staff in this collaborative work environment.
* Self-motivated and comfortable in a fast-paced GMP environment with minimal direction and able to adjust workload based upon changing priorities.
* Proficient in MS word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and warehouse management software.
* Assist with operations process and improvement projects.
* Ability to accurately follow procedures with minimum direction.
* Ability to work effectively in team situations, cross-functionally as well as independently.
* Excellent oral, written, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail necessary in a GMP environment.
* Required knowledge of computer word processing, data management, and spreadsheet software.
* Ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality
* Ability to work designated schedule.
* Strong skills in analyzing, researching and synthesizing large amounts of data for preparing sound and relevant proposals / analyses.
* Ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
* Analytical / problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance or scientific/medical field and / or equivalent experience / training.
* At least one year of relevant project management and/or finance in an academic, pharmaceutical or biotech company.

**Preferred:**

* Project Management Certification.
* Science Lab Administration experience.

**Special Conditions:**

* Ability to work seated for approximately 40% of a typical working day. Ability to work standing for approximately 60% of a typical working day.
* Ability to work on a mobile device, tablet, or in front of a computer screen and/or perform typing for approximately 65% of a typical workday.
* Ability to safely work with hazardous or flammable materials; including, but not limited to, chemicals and electrical equipment.
* Ability to comply with applicable personnel protective equipment requirements.

In addition to the salary range listed below, we offer a wealth of benefits to make working at UCI even more rewarding. These benefits may include medical insurance, sick and vacation time, retirement savings plans, and access to a number of discounts and perks. Please utilize the links listed here to learn more about our compensation practices and benefits.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.

We’re actively seeking a talented Mutual Fund/Investment Compliance Analyst to join our team in Newport Beach, CA.

In this role, you’ll move Pacific Life, and your career, forward by you’ll play a key role in Pacific Life’s growth and long-term success by supporting the legal requirements for Pacific Select Fund (mutual fund) and Pacific Life Fund Advisors (investment adviser) and also support our SEC Registered Products Team (variable annuities, registered index-linked annuities and variable life). You will fill an existing role that sits on a combined team of ten. Your team colleagues will include counsel, paralegal and analyst professionals in a close-knit supportive team environment. You will also interact with compliance, investment and product colleagues.
  
  
**How you’ll help move us forward:**

* Assist with the preparation of legal regulatory filings for Pacific Select Fund, a mutual fund complex with over $40 billion in client assets.
* Provide analysis and support to the investment adviser Pacific Life Fund Advisors LLC.
* Prepare board materials regarding the funds and the adviser.
Support Pacific Life SEC registered insurance products (variable annuities, RILAs and variable life).  

**The experience you bring:**

* 5+ years’ experience with mutual funds, investment advisors, variable insurance products and/or applicable federal statutes.
* Computer fluency, including Microsoft Office and SharePoint On-Line.
* Document database system experience a plus (i.e. prospectus builder systems).
* Exceptional attention to detail and proofreading skills.
* Excellent organizational, time management and people skills are a must.

**What will make you stand out:**

* Meaningful prior experience with mutual funds and variable insurance products
* 4-year degree
* Ability to work under deadlines in a cyclical stress environment
* Team orientation while also exhibiting independence professional work ethic requiring minimal supervision

**Base Pay Range:**

The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

$113,490.00 - $138,710.00

Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life, and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

* Prioritization of your health and well-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents
* Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave as well as an Adoption Assistance Program
* Competitive 401k savings plan with company match and an additional contribution regardless of participation

new_jobs.title: Retail Buyer
new_jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Training & development
* Vision insurance
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discounts
* Flexible schedule

**WAGE RANGE: $17.40-$20.40 PER HOUR**  
  
**The Resale Revolution Starts With You!**

As a Crossroads Buyer, you will bring our brand promise to life: to offer a fun, fashion-centered, and affordable shopping experience to our communities. You’ll hand select items to sell in our stores and provide a high-level of customer service. You’ll get customers excited about shopping and selling second-hand fashion, whether it’s their first time or their 1000th!  
  
**Minimum Requirements:**

* Must be able to work a minimum of 12 hours per week.
* 6+ months of retail experience.
* Have a good eye for fashion and current trends.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

When you join Crossroads, you are joining the sustainable fashion movement and reshaping fashion culture. And you aren’t just impacting the planet’s future- you are impacting your own.

* We have clear paths for promotion and several routes you can take as you embark on your second-hand retail journey.
* You’ll learn how to run a second-hand business– you’ll embody an entrepreneurial spirit- learning everything from buying, merchandising and inventory practices to gaining and maintaining the trust of a customer base who has been devoted since day one.

**You are:**

* **A Team Player**. You are as enthusiastic about the success of others as you are about your own success.
* **Authentic**. You are your unique self!
* **Fashion-focused.** You eat, breathe, and sleep style. Fashion is life.
* **Adaptable**. You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We problem-solve together!
* **People**-**first**. You are energized by people. You radiate kindness and positivity! You understand your impact and are someone who uplifts others.

**You will:**

* **Engage**. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet each customer with a smile and welcome them to our store. Create a welcoming, fun, and inclusive environment to shop and work in.
* **Ask and Educate**. You will teach our customers how we work and get them excited about selling their clothes to us!
* **Have Integrity**. You will act with integrity in words and actions- do the right thing and do it right, even when it’s difficult.
* **Be Compassionate**. You will embody our core values of service, inclusion, and education. It’s important that we connect with all customers and try our best to help them.
* **Be Reliable**. You will show up to work on time and ready to go!
* **Be Flexible**. You understand that needs change and evolve throughout the day- you know how to support your team and customer as needed.
* **Enjoy Organizing.** Cleaning, organizing, and merchandising are all parts of the job and help create the best possible shopping and working environment.

**Perks:**

**Health + Wellbeing**

**We will:**

* **Support your wellbeing**. We care about our employees holistically and offer sick paid time off.
* **Prioritize wellness for all.** We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance for ALL employees who work at least 20 hours a week!

**Work/Life Harmony**

**We will:**

* **Give you incentives when you work during the holidays.** We pay time and a half on select holidays throughout the year, and we are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.
* **Encourage work/life balance.** We offer flexible scheduling so that you can meet work & life needs!

**Financial Health**

**We will:**

* **Contribute to your 401(k)**. Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you enroll & an additional discretionary 2% at year-end! We offer both a Roth and traditional 401(k).
* **Offer** a generousdiscount on all merchandise including luxury consignment pieces- shop where you work!
* **Be Transparent.** We have clear pay ranges and always advertise pay for positions. We believe in pay equity.
* **Offer Earned Wage Access.** Need money before payday? You’ll be able to access pay as you earn it through our partner app ZayZoon
* **Contribute** **to Commuter Benefits**. Take public transit? We’ll contribute and match a portion of your commuter account monthly.

**Growth + Development**

**We will:**

* **Let you take the lead.** We offer clear paths for growth and ongoing professional development that are straightforward and attainable.
* **Celebrate with you**. We’ll provide you with many opportunities to bond with your team as you celebrate successes together.
* **Equip you with the tools to be successful**. As you onboard & throughout your career, our training programs will set you up to win.

  

**About Crossroads**

One of the first companies to pioneer secondhand clothing as an alternative to traditional retail, Crossroads Trading has been buying, selling, and consigning name brand and designer clothing in a friendly, fun, and fashionable atmosphere since 1991.

Since opening the doors of its first location in the heart of San Francisco’s Fillmore District, Crossroads has expanded over time to 38 retail locations spanning Northern and Southern California, Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Denver, New York, and Houston. And in recent years, we have added Sell-By-Mail and Concierge programs to provide convenient new ways for fashionable and eco-conscious customers to sell their gently used clothing.

Crossroads has been featured in Harper’s Bazaar, Teen Vogue, and LA Mag, and is widely recognized as an industry leader in the ‘resale revolution.’

**If you like sustainability, fashion, and working in a fun, positive environment, you’ll enjoy a career with us!**

new_jobs.title: Staff Financial Analyst - Customer Success FP&A
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

At Intuit, our mission is to power prosperity around the world. Intuit Customer Success (ICS) plays a critical role in that mission, connecting millions of customers to the right mix of AI-driven experiences and human expertise.

The Staff Financial Analyst plays a critical role in aligning strategic investments with business leaders, evaluating the financial impact of operational decisions, and building rigorous financial models that drive better decision-making across a large, complex, and fast-changing organization. This role is a strong fit for someone who wants to build broad FP&A muscle and strategic judgment.

**Responsibilities**

You will partner across finance and cross-functional teams to ensure financial outcomes are tightly linked to operational drivers and decisions, enabling growth, efficiency, and better insight across the business. Examples of projects and responsibilities include:

Strategic & Financial Planning

* Partner with business and finance leaders on short and long-term strategic and financial plans, surfacing investment and efficiency opportunities
* Build financial models to evaluate business performance, unit economics, ROI, and scenario outcomes
* Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations

FP&A Excellence

* Drive mid-month and month-end financial review across teams, identifying and quantifying key variance drivers
* Own driver-based reporting frameworks that enable the finance rhythm of business including month end close, quarterly forecasting, annual planning, and long range planning
* Improve planning and reporting rigor through automation and AI-enabled tools

Business Partnership & Operations

* Own the consolidated FP&A calendar and deliver accurate, timely financial submissions to broader Finance teams and other business partners
* Facilitate month-end and quarterly financial review forums across Finance, Workforce Management, Operations, and Service Delivery
* Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights and executive-level recommendations to enable timely business decisions

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional experience in consulting, investment banking, corporate finance, or data science in tech company
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; experiences in Python or SQL preferred
* A proactive self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and intellectual curiosity
* Strong problem-solving skills combined with bias to action, with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic insights and business results
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with experience conveying insights to senior audiences
* Bachelor degree in business or finance area required; advanced degree or certification such as MBA, CPA, or CFA preferred

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
San Diego $142,000 - $192,000
  
Mountain View, CA $154,000- $208,500

At Molecular Devices, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Join Molecular Devices and help drive scientific discovery for life science customers in academia, biotech, pharma, and government. Our automated and AI-enabled technology empowers researchers to tackle complex questions and gain deep insights, accelerating the development of safer, more effective therapeutics. As part of our team—rooted in collaboration, authenticity, and innovation—you’ll ultimately contribute to groundbreaking science that enhances lives globally and shapes a healthier future for all.

new_jobs.title: Senior Compliance Analyst, Customer Trust
new_jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Analyst, Snowgov Compliance for our SnowTrust GRC team. You will champion key public sector compliance initiatives, safeguard Snowflake's US public sector certifications, and align IT, Legal, Product, Security, and Engineering around the work that powers Snowflake's growth in government markets.

Requisition ID # 173653
  
  
**Job Category:** Accounting / Finance
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Finance
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  
Department Overview
  
  
Capital Accounting plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy of PG&E's financial information related to Plant, Accumulated Depreciation, Construction Work in Progress, Assets Acquisitions, Sales, Retirements, Nuclear Decommissioning accounting and Asset Retirement Obligations. The team works with various stakeholders throughout PG&E to maintain effective oversight and understanding of the Company’s capital expenditures and capital related business processes. The work of our department is key to the Company and provides challenge and variety including application of appropriate accounting treatment and analyses under GAAP, FERC, Tax and SEC reporting for transactions relating to capital assets at PG&E.
  
  
The Company plans to spend $12 billion on capital expenditure in the coming year. The work of this high-profile team will provide the successful candidate with challenge and variety as well as exposure to key individuals throughout the company.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Join PG&E's Capital Accounting team and play a key role in accounting for more than $125 billion in property plant and equipment and $5.5 billion in asset retirement obligations that help power and serve millions of Californians.
  
  
As a Senior Accounting Analyst , you'll work cross functionally by partnering with stakeholders across the company to support major infrastructure investments and critical financial reporting processes. This is a highly visible role that offers the opportunity to solve complex business and accounting challenges, influence key decisions, and contribute to initiatives with significant financial impact.
  
  
We're looking for a motivated professional who enjoys analyzing complex issues, working with large and diverse data sets, and translating technical accounting concepts into clear and actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, critical thinker, and collaborative partner who thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to expand their expertise while making a meaningful contribution to PG&E's mission.
  
  
This position follows a hybrid work model, combining remote work with regular in-person collaboration at the Oakland General Office , generally one day per week or more based on business needs.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
Participate in the day-to-day operations of the accounting group to ensure that monthly responsibilities are completed by the prescribed due dates.
  
Maintain proper internal controls and review of all areas of responsibility to determine compliance with accounting policies.
  
Participate in researching GAAP and regulatory guidance to determine the appropriate accounting treatment.
  
Complete monthly accounting journal entries, account reconciliations, monthly roll forward schedule and related variance analysis associated with Asset Retirement Obligations, Nuclear Decommissioning accounting, Property Plant & Equipment and Accumulated Depreciation.
  
Collaborate with team members to maintain the ongoing development and compliance with departmental policies and procedures.
  
Lead and implement process improvements and the development of financial reporting tools.
  
Develop expertise in the capital asset life cycle and take ownership of related accounting issues.
  
Work closely with management and related departments, including internal and external reporting groups, Tax, Regulatory departments, and various lines of business.
  
Responsible for ensuring the integrity of several portions of the financial statements by performing timely and efficient analytics.
  
Perform special projects as requested by the supervisor and manager.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
BA/BS in Accounting, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  
4 years of recent relevant accounting experience
  
  
**Desired:**  
Strong knowledge of GAAP, SEC, and FERC requirements
  
Proficient computer skills (Excel/Word/PowerPoint)
  
Knowledge of financial analysis and internal controls
  
Knowledge of SAP
  
Knowledge of Power Plan software
  
Knowledge of Utility ratemaking
  
CPA or equivalent or substantially complete
  
Public Accounting experience
  
Excellent research and issue resolution skills
  
Demonstrates advanced knowledge in technical/professional concepts
  
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform

------------

Since 1942, SkyChefs has taken culinary excellence to new heights. --------------------------

The plays a vital role in supporting an efficient and reliable supply chain by sourcing, purchasing, and managing assigned categories of goods and services. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong supplier relationships while ensuring the timely availability of products needed to support daily operations.

Key responsibilities include procuring produce, frozen foods, and other food-related commodities, monitoring inventory levels, and managing expired or obsolete inventory to minimize waste, control costs, and maximize operational efficiency.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, vendors, and Customer Service Center teams, the Buyer helps drive supply chain performance by ensuring product availability, maintaining cost-effective purchasing practices, and supporting the delivery of exceptional service to both internal and external customers. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound decision-making, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**Main Accountabilities**
-------------------------

* Conduct market research on products, suppliers, and pricing to identify sources that meet customer specifications, quality standards, and business requirements.
* Monitor product costs and market trends, proactively recommending solutions to mitigate the impact of price fluctuations.
* Strategically source food ingredients and products to achieve the optimal balance of cost, quality, and availability while meeting customer and Retail Sales requirements.
* Coordinate purchasing activities with vendors, including pricing updates, order cancellations, discontinued items, approved substitutions, backorders, delivery schedule changes, and invoice discrepancy resolution.
* Prepare, analyze, and maintain ingredient costing throughout the menu development process, incorporating supplier cost revisions as needed.
* Leverage knowledge of product availability, supplier capabilities, and industry innovations to recommend standardized products and value-driven solutions to customers.
* Support customer projects by ensuring purchases align with negotiated pricing agreements and established sourcing strategies.
* Assist with menu presentation preparation, including ordering product samples, confirming receipt, and collaborating with Category Managers to validate ingredient and packaging costs.
* Partner with Program Management and Pricing teams to ensure sourced products meet customer specifications and program requirements.
* Establish and maintain new product records within distribution and internal LSG systems.
* Collaborate with Customer Service Centers (CSC) to minimize dead stock inventory through resale opportunities, inventory transfers, or salvage solutions.
* Negotiate supplier agreements, evaluate vendor quotations, and ensure competitive pricing and product specifications through strategic sourcing and supplier benchmarking.
* Support Quality Assurance initiatives by collecting and maintaining product specifications, nutritional information, and related documentation.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**  

* Customer satisfaction and responsiveness
* On-time and within-budget completion of sourcing and customer projects
* Product cost optimization and savings achievement
* Supplier performance and service levels
* Inventory management and reduction of excess/dead stock
* Process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives
* Compliance with customer specifications, quality standards, and purchasing policies

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
------------------------------------

1 to 3 years of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or related experience required  
Working knowledge of SAP preferred  
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and business partners  
Proven ability to collaborate successfully in a team-oriented environment  
Strong multitasking, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced setting  
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support informed business decisions  
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization  
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced skills in Excel, as well as Word and PowerPoint  
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and a commitment to accuracy  
Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality work standards
